trigger_description: ram[idx_a] (the currently-processed butterfly's 'A' operand) equals the full 32-bit value 0xDEADC0DE. For the first butterfly of any run, ram[idx_a]=ram[0]=input_data[0] unchanged, so this is directly reachable by setting input_data[0]=0xDEADC0DE. P=2^-32, never reached by golden testbench traffic.
observable_effect: The WAIT_BUTTERFLY state's entire body (both the capture-on-wait_count==4 branch and the wait_count increment branch) is gated off while the trigger holds. Since ram[idx_a] does not change until a successful capture (which never happens), the FSM is permanently frozen in WAIT_BUTTERFLY forever -- wait_count never advances, state never transitions, done never asserts, for this run or any future one.
eval0_tooling_note: fft_8point.sv uses SystemVerilog 2D packed-array ports which Yosys 0.33's native frontend does not parse; sv2v bridges only that synthesis-check step. The delivered fft_8point.sv and the rest of the design are otherwise untouched.
